source.title: Homepage source: noindex
source.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026 and checked against live source. The robots tag says noindex. The page also has WebSite markup; this is not a claim that all schema is missing.

menu.title: The visible site menu
menu.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026 and checked live. Avocado Toast has a description but no visible price. There is no visible site-price mismatch.

toast-price.title: Toast shows an ordering price
toast-price.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026. Toast displays Avocado Toast at $11.95. Guests can find a price here, but not on the visible website menu.

toast-hours.title: Toast: name and ordering window
toast-hours.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026. The modal header says CAFÉX while the location footer still says Con Azucar. The displayed ordering window is not verified café opening hours.

doordash.title: DoorDash: ratings and menu window
doordash.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026. DoorDash displays 4.7 from 500+ ratings. Ratings are not the same as written reviews. Its Full Menu hours describe an ordering window.

home.title: The complete homepage
home.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026 and checked live. The homepage goes from hero to a footer marked ©2035, without on-page video, reviews or story detail. Our Story is a separate, working page.

shop.title: Shop: coming soon, with signup
shop.caption: Captured 22 Oct 2026 and checked live. Shop says Coming Soon and already has a Notify Me signup. Build on it with useful launch details.

story.title: A specific Mexican coffee story
story.caption: Captured live, 22 Oct 2026. The working Our Story page describes Nayarit coffee, Zacatecas roots and Mexican coffee culture. These are the café’s own published claims, not independently audited sourcing.

social-ig.title: Contact sends Instagram visitors to Wix
social-ig.caption: Captured live, 22 Oct 2026. Hovering the Contact page’s Instagram icon shows instagram.com/wix in Chrome’s lower-left link preview. The footer uses the correct CAFÉX account.

social-fb.title: Contact sends Facebook visitors to Wix
social-fb.caption: Captured live, 22 Oct 2026. The Contact page’s Facebook icon previews facebook.com/wix. These are template links in the contact section, not broken navigation links.
